newsitem.title: USA: Sara Lee gives Lustig new role.
newsitem.headline: Sara Lee gives Lustig new role.

text.p: Sara Lee Corp said Tuesday Paul Lustig, who now oversees Pacific Rim apparel businesses, will be given responsibility for four U.S.-based personal products units and relinquish his corporate strategy management role.
Lustig, who is 46, was appointed senior vice president of corporate strategy and chief executive of Sara Lee's Pacific Rim apparel divisions in 1996, Sara Lee said.

He will take on the additional role of overseeing four U.S.-based personal products businesses: Sara Lee Hosiery, Sara Lee Direct, Sara Lee Sock Co and Sara Lee's "Just My Size" line of intimate apparel, hosiery and casual wear, the company said.
